views.evidence: Filled navy review and confirm buttons stand out from the form; shaded recipient and received-amount blocks help scan the desktop review. The mobile estimate remains below the form.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports insufficient contrast for the small orange step eyebrow in initial desktop and mobile states; some contrast checks are incomplete.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization removed button fills and the tinted recipient/received amount emphasis, making the actions and grouping less distinct.

views.evidence: A dark outlined selected glaze and filled add button improve action and selection recognition, while small muted labels, stock and disclosure are harder to read. Delivery and returns remain collapsed below add.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports multiple contrast violations in desktop and mobile initial and final states, including navigation and image-note text; contrast checks also include incomplete results.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutral swatches looked like identical empty boxes; authored color and outline distinguish Iron from Sand and the selected option.

views.evidence: Selected glaze has a dark border, tinted background and radio indicator; the dark cart button clearly follows the delivery, returns and total. Mobile retains the same long image-first ordering.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports no violations in the captured initial and final states, but has incomplete contrast checks; that is not a conformance finding.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization removed swatch colors and the selected card tint, although the radio indicator remained visible.

views.evidence: Green filled review and confirm actions are easier to identify and tint separates recipient and received amount. Small pale helper and summary labels are visually subdued, while the large slogan still precedes the task.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports missing programmatic labels on recipient and amount inputs in initial desktop and mobile states, despite visible text; it also flags multiple contrast failures across states and incomplete checks.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization hid the action fills and tinted summary emphasis. The authored packet does not include a failure screenshot, so it cannot resolve the cramped mobile failure summary observed in neutral.

views.evidence: Green action buttons and a tinted received amount establish a clearer action and calculation hierarchy; the mobile stack still places review below the breakdown.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports no violations or incomplete results in the captured states; this is not a conformance assessment.
The packet reports 320px horizontal overflow; no 320px image identifies the affected content.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: The neutral version lost filled primary actions and the received-amount background; layout and the reported narrow overflow remain relevant.

views.evidence: Orange shortage badges and a tinted selected row make triage and selection easier to scan, with text labels reinforcing status. Muted helper and stock metadata appear light.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe flags contrast failures for eyebrow, intro, muted text and item metadata in desktop and mobile states; initial checks also contain incomplete results.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization removed status badge colors and selected-row tint, though the shortage text and quantities were still present.

views.evidence: A border and pale fill identify the selected glaze, with labeled colored swatches and a dark add button; item total remains above delivery and returns, which still follow the action.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports contrast failures for small stock text in initial and final desktop and mobile states, with incomplete contrast checks.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization removed the swatch colors, selected fill and button fill; the checkmark remained.

views.evidence: Colored shortage pills, selected row tint and a filled record button improve scanning and action hierarchy, but the already small table headings and metadata are pale.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports numerous contrast violations in desktop and mobile states, including stock-table column headings; incomplete checks remain.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization removed selected-row and status color cues, making the relationship between list and detail less apparent.

views.evidence: Blue selected-row tint and filled save button clarify the active item and primary action; orange shortage text supplements explicit numeric labels. The mobile list retains its compact ratios.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports no violations or incomplete results in captured desktop and mobile states; this does not establish accessibility conformance.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization removed the selection tint and button fill, while the core ratio and shortage labels were preserved.

views.evidence: The chosen glaze has a distinct border, unavailable Ash has hatching and text, and the filled selection button is conspicuous. Returns remain in the lower details section after the action.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports no violations or incomplete results in captured initial and final states; this is not a full accessibility assessment.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization stripped swatch colors, unavailable hatching and the primary button fill, weakening visible selection cues.

views.evidence: A filled green confirm button and tinted cost panel distinguish action from summary; on mobile the summary still follows the first-step action and the captured desktop review separates cost from confirmation. Some supporting text is faint.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe reports contrast violations across desktop and mobile states, including amount help, account metadata, review labels and rate; some contrast checks are incomplete.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: Neutralization removed the tinted cost panel, account background, active step fill and primary button fill; the mobile ordering concern remains.

views.evidence: The LIN-115 row is visible in both authored full images and selected desktop review, with SKU, available 2 and Short 8; selection tint and filled record action help. On mobile the long item name is truncated and secondary text is very small and pale.
observedAccessibilityIssues: Axe flags many color-contrast failures across desktop and mobile states, including headings and subtitle, with incomplete checks.
The mobile list truncates the target item name; the full name is available in the desktop review capture, but a mobile authored detail screenshot was not supplied.
views.neutralJudgmentCaveat: The target row that appeared entirely blank in neutral is visible in authored captures; neutralization materially distorted the original list. The neutral blocker applies to that diagnostic capture, not the authored screenshot.
